spans.text: Inside the Griffin base, the Café has finally returned to its usual hustle and bustle as more and more Dolls are revived.
The commotion-loving Dolls are gathered here, toasting each other happily to celebrate their rebirth.
Now that the last of the Sangvis plant investigation missions are over, the Dolls have dragged me to this crowded place.
After fooling around with them for a while, the Dolls finally lose interest in messing with me, and I can free myself to get a drink.
I look around at the venue and finally spot Kalina in a dimly-lit corner.
She looks completely exhausted. Clearly she must have spent many sleepless nights to get the Dolls back into normal working order.
I hesitate briefly, then head over to her, drink in hand.
I stand beside her and tilt my head, questioning. She looks up at me, then lowers her head once more.
Fortunately, she hasn't fled this time, so I take it as implicit permission to sit at the same table.
Still angry?
Not really...
Then why aren't you having fun with the others?
I'm scared that I won't be able to see something like this again, so I want to sit aside and just watch quietly.
...For some reason, gloomy things like that sound strange coming from you.
Hey, even I can feel down at times, you know!
So you're still mad, huh...
I take another look at Kalina, and I suddenly realize that in spite of all the battles she has experienced, she's still just a girl in her twenties.
I've always taken her strength and reliability as a given, and my taking her for granted, combined with my presumptuousness, must have been very hurtful.
Kalina is still rather huffy. She opens her mouth as if to speak, but changes her mind after a hesitant pause.
After some thought, I've come to the conclusion that since she got angry because of me, I should be the one to offer an olive branch.
It's been nearly a week. Have you decided what you're going to do yet?
Kalina's eyes darken at the question. She takes a sip out of her drink and redirects the question to me in a nonchalant tone.
Have YOU decided what you're going to do, Commander?
Hm... Well, since the Dolls are all repaired...
Naturally, we ought to put them through a standard 24-day course of combat simulations.
We need to get our Dolls back into shape. I'm guessing you may need to spend a bit more time fine-tuning them.
Oh... Wait, what?? So...you're not going to leave us?
I never ever said I would leave...
R...Really?
So you're really not going to quit your post?
I told you, didn't I? I threw that Green Zone ID pass into the trash on the first day. It's probably in pieces in the garbage disposal now.
Yeah, I know that.
But you never gave me a definite answer, and you told me to go off by myself...
I was kidding, of course. I'd have a really hard time if you actually left.
After all, I don't want to take all that logistics work onto myself.
Really?
You're not lying to me again, are you?
But I never lied to you in the first place...
If you don't believe me, you can search my body and see if that ID pass is still there.
And if that doesn't work for you, you can search my room too.
But right now, I'm not going anywhere.
Com...Commander, you...you big jerk! I was so worried!
Do you know what I've been going through this whole week?
Not a day went by when I wasn't thinking about what I'd do if you suddenly decided to leave us!
I was...worried sick...every day... (Sobs)
I...I'm sorry... At first I was just messing with you.
But I didn't expect you to give me the cold shoulder after that...
That's because I WAS mad!
I was thinking, "If you're going to suddenly vanish someday, then I should just keep my distance from you!"
I...I see... But then why...
But I...I just couldn't do it!
I was going to avoid you altogether, but I found myself in the Command Room each day before I realized it!
I...I'm so sorry...
How about this... Wait, let me think... Ah, I've got it! As an apology, why don't we swap jobs?
What?!
That is to say, you get to be the Commander and give me orders, and I'll be your adjutant. I mean, we don't have any missions pending, so we can probably do it for a day...
Commander... Are you serious about that?
Yep.
I'll do anything you want. You can take your anger out on me anytime.
How...how's that?
Pffft...
Pff...hahahaha!
Well, that's our Commander for you, you always come up with stuff that normal people could never even conceive of. That's so dumb!
If you were our logistics officer, I doubt any of our Dolls would have working weapons if they went out on a mission.
In the end, I'd get yelled at anyway.
So what can I do to make it up to you?
Hmm... Let me think...
You're not allowed to lie to me for the rest of your life.
How about that, Commander? Do you think you can keep that promise?
Is that all?
Yeah, that's all.
Then I promise you, I won't lie to you ever again.
Hehehe, you'd better keep your word, okay?
Ten years later, as I look out through the train windows at the quarantine wall under the setting sun in the distance, I think back to this scene.
The orange-yellow light of dusk spreads over the quarantine wall and limns it in a golden glow, like syrup on a pancake.
As I recall all the things that have gone by, it suddenly occurs to me just how much that brief period of respite in my life has meant to me.
At that time, I did not realize how lucky and happy I was.
As everything changed with the passage of time, the faces of the past had blurred into unreachability with each day that went by.
I recall the words I couldn't say when I bade her farewell just now. I know that even if I had said them, they would have been pointless anyway.
Even if I am still my old self, she is no longer the same woman.
However, I do not resent her for changing, because in the end, I have not been able to keep the promise I made her ten years ago.
(Yawns)... I'm so sleepy all of a sudden.
Now that I'm not worried anymore, the fatigue from the past few days has caught up with me all at once...
Go back to the dorm and get some rest. There's no telling how long the Dolls are going to keep this up.
We'll worry about the cleanup tomorrow.
O...Okay...
Then I'll see you tomorrow, Commander...
(Yawns) So sleepy...
Kalina drags her exhausted body out of the Café.
Hopefully she'll be back to normal tomorrow. Having a grim-faced adjutant standing behind me was sending chills down my spine.
Is this seat taken, Commander?
...What are you doing here?
Didn't I tell you not to show up in front of the others?
Well, the only other human who can see me besides yourself has already gone to bed, so coming out for a stroll shouldn't be a problem.
...Have you been spying on us again?
I'm just curious about the relationship you have with your adjutant.
But I didn't expect her to be so tractable.
It's almost as if the two of you were trying to beat each other in being the biggest pushover.
Ahem, did you come all the way just to make fun of me?
I've obtained some information, but it's not particularly urgent.
After all, such moments of respite are precious and fleeting.
There's no harm in letting it wait.
I follow her gaze to the center of the Café, and the raucous atmosphere washes over me like a wave.
Quit struggling and let me pinch you!
Ugh... Let go... My face...
Help me... Ughh...
Hahahaha, Gr G11's face looks so dorky!
It looks fun, I want to pinch her too!
Pipe down. The head maid's going to come over and scold us.
Alright, you girls, don't make trouble in the Café. Go back to the dorms if you want to fool around.
Uwah! Run for it!
Don't run around in the Café! It's dangerous—you'll hit someone!
Let them off this once, Gr G36. It's good that the place is so lively after so long.
(Sighs) From tolerance all sin is born.
These Dolls make trouble in the Café because you're always so lenient.
I exhale and look away from them.
This normal, everyday life with no surprises is what I'm trying to protect with every fiber of my being.
So, what is this information you were talking about?
Ooh, eager, aren't we. Are you in such a hurry to go on a mission again?
I don't want to end up regretting my present laziness in the future.
In that case, come with me.
Dandelion rises and leaves the Café.
I give Springfield a nod, then put on my coat and follow her out.
It's not fall yet, but there's a chill in the air outdoors.
Huh, so you're all here.
As I expected, the AR Team is gathered in a clearing outside the base.
I've brought the Commander along, as I promised.
Thank you, you've done us a favor.
Did you send Dandelion to find me?
Why didn't you come over in person?
The idea of going in there somehow makes me a bit uncomfortable...
After all, it's best for us to keep a distance from the other Dolls, since we're members of the AR Team and all.
I knew the Commander would come, now the Commander is allllll ours!
That sounds a little frightening, coming from you...
Ahem... Actually, we asked you out here today because we have an imposition to make.
I know it might cause you trouble but please hear us out.
Dandelion, please show the Commander.
Here, Commander, look at this.
This house is...?
There's no doubt about it. This is the house which keeps appearing in Lunasia's neural cloud.
It is her "home", stored in the depths of her memories.
I once saw this place on the base layer of her neural cloud.
Havier's intelligence network seems to have news about Ange's work in Germany. Their Stasi over there seems to have found an identical house to this one.
You hacked into Havier's computer?!
I just left a little, tiny backdoor. He won't notice it.
It was Ange's activities in Germany which led to the Stasi discovering this place by accident.
Looks like Ange's gone through a lot over there...
So what do you have in mind?
Commander, the AR Team has decided. We won't give up on looking for M4 or M16 no matter what.
No matter how big the world is, I believe that as long as we continue existing within it, we will meet again someday.
Therefore, we're hoping that we can find a way to get to that place and see if we can obtain a lead about M4.
Of course, I know this might make things rather difficult for you, but please let us leave you for a while. I'm sure we'll bring back good news.
I refuse.
Huh?
If we're looking for our lost Dolls, I cannot let just the few of you go off by yourselves.
Commander, what do you mean?
While I can't make any guarantees right now, I'll try to verify the information about that house.
If it warrants a proper investigation, I won't just send the AR Team by yourselves and expose you to danger.
Don't worry. As a Commander of Griffin, I won't leave any Dolls behind.
Awesome, the Commander has the same idea!
Yeah, I won't leave anyone behind.
But you need to promise me that you'll obey orders once the mission begins and you won't run off on your own.
We are a team; every person and every Doll here is your friend and your comrade, and our fates are bound together.
Can you promise me that?
The three Dolls exchange glances and nod in unison.
I nod back in acknowledgement.
I will give thorough consideration to the entire plan. Also, Persica will be arriving tomorrow. You should let her give you all a checkup.
Now, since that's still a few hours away, why don't you head over to the Café and have some fun?
Thanks, but no thanks, Commander.
We'll be off then. You should get some rest too.
Right. Good night.
The Dolls take their leave, talking and laughing.
I look at RO's receding back and realize that she's become a lot more mature than before.
I stick my hands into my pockets. For some reason, I feel much more at ease now.
You promised the moon so casually, Commander.
Did I make the wrong choice?
You want to find M4 too, don't you?
Indeed, that is what I want. I also know we will have to pay a price to achieve that.
So you're saying I shouldn't have made that promise?
I simply think you might not be ready yet.
But we've won all this time, haven't we?
If we stand still, then all our efforts will be wasted.
I simply want to do something for those girls. After all, their previous sacrifices deserve to be repaid.
You have a point.
And you WOULD think like this now. I do wish you will never change.
Spoken like you know my future.
You could say that.
Huh?
But the future is not set in stone, so remember our promises.
Before you step into the grave, tell me what you think of this world.
Until then, never stop striving, never stop struggling. That's the most interesting thing about humans, after all.
